description: SS 6655(g)(1): the estimated-tax base includes SS 59A BEAT. TY2026 large corporation: TI = 800M - 700M = 100M -> SS 11 tax 21,000,000; BEAT (test met, receipts 800M >= 500M): MTI = 100M + 150M benefits = 250M x 10.5% = 26,250,000 - 21,000,000 regular = 5,250,000. RAP = 21,000,000 + 5,250,000 = 26,250,000 -> quarterly 25% = $6,562,500.00. (v1 used the SS 11 tax alone and understated by $1,312,500/quarter.)
